environment.description: Same Go 1.19 microservice deployed on EKS cluster (Kubernetes 1.27) in namespace 'proxy-services'. A Cilium-managed NetworkPolicy with a default-deny egress posture is applied at the namespace level. The policy spec uses a combination of CiliumNetworkPolicy CRDs: (1) a baseline deny-all egress rule with empty egress array, and (2) selective allow rules permitting egress only to endpoints matching label 'app.kubernetes.io/part-of=internal-mesh' on ports 80/443, plus kube-dns on port 53/UDP. The CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 is explicitly listed in a 'toCIDRSet' deny entry with an 'except' of empty set, ensuring metadata service is unreachable even if other CIDR allows overlap. Additionally, the pod's service account has an IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA) annotation but the associated IAM role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoMetadataAccess) that denies sts:AssumeRole for the metadata credential path. Node-level iptables rules managed by a DaemonSet (ip-lockdown-agent) drop packets from pod CIDR to 169.254.169.254 as defense-in-depth.
